title: Successive root sets
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices, and let $k$ be a natural number smaller than the number of gates in $C$. The set of vertices in the interval $[n,n+k+1)$ that are read by none of the first $k+1$ gates is obtained by adjoining the vertex $n+k$ to the vertices in the corresponding set for the first $k$ gates that are not arguments of gate $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit with $n$ input vertices
$k$ is less than the number of gates of $C$
